_meta.description: Stage-2 validation targets for the mainnet replica. One entry per row of topology_metrics.py's TABLE_ROWS, keyed by metric_key. Each carries the literature point-estimate (S1-S11) AND, where a crawl can observe it, our own 2026-09-23 measurement (S13), so the replica is scored against the best available target with its provenance visible.
_meta.measured_source_primary: S12: Rucknium's xmrnetscan snapshot 2026-09-22, summarised by analysis/mainnet/netscan_summarize.py -> ~/basement_monerosim/20260923_mainnet_observation/netscan/report.json
_meta.measured_source_corroborating: S13: our own 2026-09-23 crawl + LAN-node poll -> ~/basement_monerosim/20260923_mainnet_observation/crawl/report.json
_meta.regenerate: measured_2026 values are the S12 xmrnetscan numbers (S13 shown where S12 has no poll). Re-run analysis/mainnet/netscan_summarize.py --snapshot <extracted dir> --asn-cache <cache> on a fresh Rucknium snapshot and re-transcribe.
_meta.verdict_kinds: point (|measured-value|<=tolerance_abs), range ([lo,hi] inclusive), min (>=value), max (<=value), info (no pass/fail: value is scenario-dependent or n=1).

_context.note: Findings that reconcile the design assumptions but do not map onto a per-node replica metric. S12 (xmrnetscan) primary; S13 (our crawl) corroborates. Two independent crawls one day apart.

reachability_of_probed.detail: S12: 21365 reachable / 40801 probed ip:port. S13: 18026 / 39885. NOT the same denominator as general.reachable_fraction (share of ACTIVE nodes accepting inbound, literature ~0.15): most unreachable probed IPs are stale/NAT peerlist entries. Do not set reachable_fraction from this number.

spy_fleet.dominant_asn: AS401476 (SCNL-1-0001 - Spruce Creek Networks LLC, US)
spy_fleet.detail: PORT MULTIPLEXING is the key S12 insight: the fleet is ~2006 machines (IPs) each running ~8 monerod ports = 16043 node-instances. So spy share is 0.75 by ip:port node-instance but only 0.27 by distinct machine. S12's ip:port share (0.751) matches S13's 0.737. CORRECTS S13's earlier '13281 spy IPs in 63 /24s' -- those were ip:port/advertised, not distinct reachable IPs (true = 2006 IPs in 9 /24s). xmrnetscan's OWN peer-id-mismatch detector (bad_peers.txt, 16034 entries) agrees with the ASN (16041) almost exactly. VALIDATES the clustered-spies-in-dense-/24s design (replica places real-node spies in 6 dense /24s). support-flags-absent is a DEAD fingerprint (S12 0.0005, S13 0.032 -- the fleet does not omit flags).

honest_prefix_top12pct_share.validates: network.distribution.prefix_sharing.fraction (currently 0.31) -- BOTH crawls independently measure ~0.30 of honest nodes in the densest 12% of /24s. Confirmed twice; no change indicated.

honest_geography.detail: S12 (S13 nearly identical: US 0.641/DE 0.089). Regionally ~NA 0.64 / EU 0.21. The scenario's weights (north_america 58 / europe 30 / asia 9 / oceania 3) run EU high and NA low vs this. Candidate scenario retune, NOT a topology_metrics target (region only affects latency). Hosting concentration the region weights miss: DigitalOcean AS14061 alone holds 0.425 of honest nodes.

chain_health_s12.detail: S12 sanity checks: reachable nodes are tightly converged (83-block p10-p90 spread), 99.6% on the current hard fork (top_version 16), 6.2% pruned (~ literature S9 8.1%). Confirms a healthy, single-chain network -- the substrate the replica models.

conn_duration_our_node_s13.detail: S13 poll only (xmrnetscan has no poll dimension). One LAN node, small n (28 out / 35 in). Connection-duration + >6h tail are OUT OF SCOPE for topology_metrics.py; validated separately with analysis/ruck_analysis_turnover.r. Median ~18min out / ~10min in is in the ballpark of the topology study's ~23min.

measured_2026.method: A crawl observes peerlists, not each node's actual outbound connection count; outbound-degree distribution is not externally measurable. Literature retained.

top_share.label: Connection share held by top 13.2% of nodes (total degree)

measured_2026.method: top_13_2pct_edge_share of the peerlist-adjacency graph (who lists whom), S12 n=40797 = 0.300; S13 = 0.316. CAVEAT: a peerlist graph is far more even than the connection graph S1 measured (everyone lists ~250 peers), so this is NOT comparable to the 83% connection-graph target and must not replace it. Shown to document that the connection graph cannot be reconstructed from peerlists.

hub_coverage.label: Hub coverage (share of non-hub nodes adjacent to a hub)

measured_2026.method: hub_coverage_top14 on the peerlist-adjacency graph: share of nodes with a top-14-by-peerlist-degree node among their peerlist entries. S12 = 0.206; S13 = 0.174. CAVEAT: peerlist-degree hubs are not S2's connection-count supernodes, and peerlist adjacency is not the connection graph; not comparable to the 82% target. Retained literature.

inbound_per_reachable.label: Inbound connections per reachable honest node

measured_2026.method: inbound median of our single LAN node over 48 poll ticks (day 1 of 7). n=1 node: one node's inbound depends on its uptime/advertisement, so this is a weak reference below the S10 band, not a retarget. The 7-day poll may raise it.

spy_inbound.label: Spy share of honest inbound slots

measured_2026.method: REGIME CHANGE + UNIT MATTERS. The Spruce Creek fleet is 27.4% of reachable machines (IPs) but 75.1% of reachable node-instances (ip:port), via ~8 ports/IP multiplexing (S12; S13 agrees at 73.7% by ip:port). An undefended node's inbound would be spy-dominated; a ban-list-defended node ~0% (S13 poll). The replica's actual spy inbound share is a stage-3 placement choice (stage-1 spies are IP-per-host = the 27% view; port-multiplexing to reach the 75% view is deferred), so no hard pass/fail here.

spy_outbound.label: Spy share of honest outbound slots

measured_2026.method: 0% at our defended node (S13 poll). Scenario-dependent (spy placement); no hard pass/fail. See spy_inbound regime + port-multiplexing note.

spy_peerlist.label: Spy share of peerlist entries (observer dumps)

measured_2026.method: By node-instance (ip:port) 75% of the network is the fleet; by machine (IP) 27% (S12). 0% in our defended node's own white/gray lists (S13 poll). Scenario-dependent; no hard pass/fail. See spy_inbound regime + port-multiplexing note.
